meta.title: Jungle Padel — indoor padel club in Pantelimon · Opening March 2027
meta.description: Four indoor padel courts, a lounge suspended 3 metres up between them, Reformer Pilates and a league with live rankings. Facilities designed to the highest European standards. Join the waitlist.

hero.title: Watch the game from three metres up.
hero.lead: Four indoor padel courts, a gallery lounge 3 metres up between them and a club where everything, from booking to payment, runs digitally. Facilities designed to the highest European standards.
hero.renderAlt: 3D rendering, evening: the view from the gallery lounge 3 metres up, over the glass balustrade, towards the glass-walled padel courts lit by LED lines.
hero.renderNote: Illustrative 3D rendering made by us from the club's sketch. Not a photograph and not the final design.

arena.title: Four courts. One standard.
arena.lead: Enclosed padel courts in a hall heated in winter and cooled in summer, with a sound system and lighting for matches, training and club nights.

stats.climate: seasons of play, in the climate-controlled hall

points: A gallery lounge 3 m up, between the two rows of courts
A screen at every court: players, rank and time left

ecosystem.title: From booking to leaving, no queues and no paperwork.
ecosystem.lead: One account and one digital card connect everything: booking, access, the league and payment.

steps.title: Book online
steps.text: Choose the court, time and duration, any time and as far ahead as you like.

steps.title: Get your digital card
steps.text: Your member card with a QR code arrives by email and you can keep it on your phone.

steps.title: Check in with one gesture
steps.text: Scan your card on arrival and at the court entrance. Attendance is recorded automatically.

steps.title: Play
steps.text: The court screen shows the match, the players and the time left.

steps.title: The score, confirmed by everyone
steps.text: At the league kiosk, every player scans their card and confirms the result.

steps.title: Pay or split the hour
steps.text: At the payment kiosk everyone pays their share. The fiscal receipt is issued automatically.

steps.title: Leave. It's all in your account.
steps.text: Bookings, payments, attendance and league progress, all visible in your account.

facilities.title: Everything you need, under one roof.

lockers.title: Changing rooms
lockers.text: Spaces to change, designed for comfort before and after play.

pilates.title: Reformer pilates
pilates.text: A studio in the building next door, heated and cooled: 4 Reformer machines at opening, up to 6. Classes by level, private and duo sessions.

events.title: Event room
events.text: A separate room, in the same building as the Pilates studio, for parties and private events of 15–20 people.

lounge.title: Specialty café & lounge
lounge.text: Specialty coffee on the ground floor, with stairs up to the gallery lounge above the courts.

facilities.rendersSoon: Photorealistic renderings of these spaces will be added from the architectural project.
facilities.lead: Changing rooms, a Pilates studio, an event room and a café, designed as parts of the same club.

league.title: A serious ranking. A card that shows your status.
league.lead: Every official match updates your points and rank. Seasons last 3 months and the rankings are live, online and in the club. Your member card reflects the rank you reach.
rules: Scores are entered only at the league kiosk in the club and validated only when every player confirms them.
Three ladders: doubles, singles and pairs.
A minimum number of matches per season for the final ranking: nobody reaches the top from a single match.
Reach Diamond and you receive a special physical card.

padel.title: Easy to start. Hard to stop.
padel.lead: Padel is played two against two, on a 20 × 10 metre court enclosed by glass walls. The ball may bounce off the walls, and the points are counted as in tennis.

court.label: Diagram of a standard padel court, seen from above
court.caption: Diagram of a standard padel court: 20 × 10 m, glass at both ends and along the first metres of the sides, mesh in between. Illustrative, not the club's courts.

easy.title: Why it is easy to start
easy.racket: The racket is short and has no strings: you hit the ball cleanly from the first minutes.
easy.serve: The serve is underarm, the ball struck no higher than the waist.
easy.walls: The walls keep the ball in play: long rallies from your very first match.
easy.social: It is played in fours: a social sport, for every level.

courts.title: Our courts
courts.text: Four indoor courts with glass walls, in a hall heated in winter and cooled in summer. At each court, a screen with the players and the time left.

lessons.title: Lessons with coaches
lessons.text: Private, duo and group sessions. When you create your account you fill in a level questionnaire, which a coach then validates.

booking.title: How to book
booking.text: Online or at the reception, on a 30-minute grid: 60, 90, 120, 150 or 180 minutes, between 08:00 and 23:00 (peak 17:00–22:00). The hour is paid and shared between the players. Prices will be announced before the opening.

formats.title: Tournament formats
formats.lead: The club's tournaments are played as knockouts, in groups or round robin, and also in these three padel formats:

americano.title: Americano
americano.text: Your partner changes every round: each player partners every other player exactly once.

mexicano.title: Mexicano
mexicano.text: The next round follows the standings so far, in groups of four: 1st with 4th against 2nd and 3rd. Ever closer matches.

king.title: King of the Court
king.text: Winners move up a court, losers move down. On the first court you play for the throne.

level.title: What's your level?
level.lead: A few questions, one minute, and you will know where you would sit on padel's level scale, from 1 to 7, and where to start with us.
level.noscript: The simulator needs JavaScript. You can also fill in the level questionnaire when you create your account.

padel.title: How long have you been playing padel?

first.label: First steps
first.hint: The basic shots work sometimes; a ball coming off the wall still surprises me.

rallies.label: I keep rallies going
rallies.hint: I know the rules and my place on court; volleys and my first shots off the wall appear.

walls.label: I play off the walls
walls.hint: I play off the wall with direction, use the lob on purpose, and my volley is steady.

tactics.label: I build the point
tactics.hint: Reliable bandeja and víbora, good exits from the corner, few unforced errors.

competition.label: Tournament player
competition.hint: A complete game without obvious weak spots; results in club or regional tournaments.

elite.label: National circuit
elite.hint: Results on national circuits, close to ranked players.

racket.title: Have you played tennis or another racket sport?

frequency.title: How often do you play now?

goal.title: What do you want now?
goal.play: To play with others, for fun

result.title: Your estimated level
result.error: We can't work out your level right now. Please try again in a few moments.
result.officialHelp: You fill it in when you create your account, and your answers here pre-fill it. A coach validates it before your first league match.
result.note: An indicative estimate, with the same formula as the official questionnaire. We don't keep your answers. In the league, your level is then calculated from your match results.

intro_lesson.title: An introductory lesson
intro_lesson.text: With a coach you learn the basic shots, the rules and how to use the walls. The best start.

coaching.title: Lessons with a coach
coaching.text: Private, duo or group sessions, to move up to the next level.

open_matches.title: Open matches
open_matches.text: Play in fours, with players of a similar level. You book the court and the hour is shared between the players.

league.title: Jungle League
league.text: Official matches, with rank, LP and standings, for adults (18+). Before your first match: the level questionnaire validated by a coach and the consent signed at the League Kiosk.

b10.name: Complete beginner
b10.text: Your first hours of padel. The basic shots work sometimes, and a ball coming off the wall is still a surprise.

b15.name: Beginner
b15.text: Short rallies at a slow pace. You let the ball go past the wall, but you don't control it yet.

b20.name: Advanced beginner
b20.text: The basic shots, controlled at low speed. You know the rules and your place on court; your serve is reliable.

b25.name: Early intermediate
b25.text: Longer rallies. Volleys and the first shots off the wall appear; you move up to the net together with your partner.

b30.name: Intermediate
b30.text: You play off the wall in most situations, with direction. You use the defensive lob on purpose; your volley is steady at medium pace.

b35.name: Good intermediate
b35.text: You control the pace: you choose between a lob, a slow ball and an attack. The bandeja comes into play; you move in tandem with your partner.

b40.name: Advanced intermediate
b40.text: Reliable bandeja and víbora, good exits from the corner. You build the point with intent, with few unforced errors.

b45.name: Advanced
b45.text: A variety of spins and speeds; smashes out of the court on easy balls. You read your opponents and anticipate.

b50.name: Strong advanced
b50.text: A complete game without obvious weak spots. Constant pressure at the net, solid defence from the back.

b55.name: Competition
b55.text: Club and regional tournament level: elaborate tactics, reliable winners, good fitness over long matches.

b60.name: High competition
b60.text: Results on national circuits, close to ranked players. At 7: professional level.

league.title: From Bronze to King of the Jungle.
league.lead: A league with ranks, league points (LP) and three-month seasons, for adults (18+). Scores are entered and confirmed only at the League Kiosk, at the club; on the website you follow the league live.

ranks.title: The ranks
ranks.label: The league's ranks, from Bronze to King of the Jungle
ranks.rules: At 100 LP you move up a division and keep the surplus. Below 0 LP you drop a division and start from 75 LP. After a promotion, your next 3 matches cannot demote you.

even.title: Even teams: about ±20
even.text: Between teams of the same level, a win brings about 20 LP and a loss costs about as much.

upset.title: An upset is worth more
upset.text: Beat a stronger team and you win more; lose to it and you lose less. A win brings between 3 and 60 LP, a loss costs between 3 and 60.

level.title: Your level pulls you towards your rank
level.text: If your level is above your current rank, you climb faster and lose less; if it is below, the reverse.

tournament.title: Tournaments: ×1.5
tournament.text: Tournament matches bring 1.5 times more LP, plus bonuses for the rounds you reach.

placement.title: The first 5 matches: placement
placement.text: They bring no LP: they set your starting rank, at most Platinum IV.

seasons.title: Three-month seasons
seasons.text: At the start of each season LP goes back to 0, and your rank is set again after 3 re-placement matches. The final standings and the prizes count those who played at least 12 official matches in the season. The first season, "Season 0 – Calibration", lasts one month and has no prizes.

rewards.title: The season's prizes
rewards.ranks: The top 3 of each rank choose: 15% off their subscription or 4 vouchers of 20% off bookings.
rewards.kings: The Kings of the Jungle (top 3) also get 2 free hours, a box of balls and a special card.
rewards.diamond: On promotion to Diamond you get a new physical card, with a jungle emblem of your choice.

sim.title: The points simulator
sim.lead: Choose the levels, your rank and the result, and see how many LP you win or lose. The league engine does the calculation, on the server, with the season's values.
sim.error: We can't calculate right now. Please try again in a few moments.
sim.towards: At level {level}, the league takes you, over time, towards {rank}.
sim.note: A simulation of a regular doubles match between players with a season of matches behind them; in the league, how certain each player's level is also counts. Nothing is saved.

standings.empty: The standings appear after the season's first matches.

tennis.title: Tennis, at Clubul Tenis Elite.
tennis.lead: You play tennis at our tennis club in Pantelimon, Clubul Tenis Elite, with programmes for children and adults. The two clubs go together: the same combined subscriptions, lessons with coaches and Pilates for players.

packages.title: Combined subscriptions

tennis.booking: You'll find the tennis courts, their hours and rates at Clubul Tenis Elite.

mothers.name: Reformer for mothers

faq.title: In short, before you come.
faq.lead: The club's basic rules. The full text is in the Terms and conditions.

hours.q: When is the club open, and what are the peak hours?
hours.a: The club is open every day from 08:00 to 23:00. The peak is from 17:00 to 22:00.

durations.q: How long can a booking be?
durations.a: From 60 to 180 minutes, in steps of 30: 60, 90, 120, 150 or 180. You can book as far ahead as you like.

cancel.a: At least 24 hours before, cancelling costs nothing: a subscription session is made up, and a paid rental becomes credit in your account. Less than 24 hours before, the booking is paid.

noShow.q: And if I don't turn up?
noShow.a: If no player scans their card within the first 15 minutes, the booking is paid. After a third no-show, the coach in charge decides whether you can book again.

pay.a: At the Payments Kiosk in the club, in cash: each player pays their part, or the organiser pays it all. A booking made online is paid at the club.

credits.q: Do I have to buy credits for padel?
credits.a: No. You pay for the court hour, and the players share it.

league.a: Anyone aged 18 or over who signs the league's GDPR form at the League Kiosk in the club.

scores.a: Only at the League Kiosk in the club, and they count only once every player confirms them. On the website and on phones, the league is only followed.
